meta.note: Durations are the main workout only. Add a 10 min warm-up and 5 min cool-down.

notation.M/W: Numbers written a/b are men/women (e.g. 20/15 cal, 6/4 kg).
notation.race weights (Men/Women Open): Sled push 152/102 kg, sled pull 103/78 kg (sled included), farmers 2x24/2x16 kg, sandbag 20/10 kg, wall ball 6/4 kg.
notation.P1/P2: Partner 1 / partner 2 in the team version.
notation.Solo / Team: Every workout has a solo and a team-of-2 version. The team version adds work and says how to share it: split as you wish (one partner works at a time), you go / I go (alternate turns), or synchro (together). Until you pick one, a workout opens on the version it was written for.
notation.EnMOM: Every n minutes on the minute: start the work at the top of each interval, rest for what is left. The work is sized to leave about a fifth of each interval to rest; if you have under 10 s left, cut the reps or metres.
notation.AMRAP: As many rounds and reps as possible in the time.

weeklyRotation.Wednesday: Partner day: written for teams of 2 (moderate), solo version included
weeklyRotation.Friday: For time: a different format each week, from chippers to race simulations (hard)

substitutions.no sled: Heavy DB/KB bear crawl push or prowler on turf; pull = heavy rope pull or 2x heavy KB walking backwards.
substitutions.no SkiErg: Row same metres, or 2x the calories on the assault bike.
substitutions.masters 45+: Cap hard days at two per week (Tue + Fri). Do Mon/Wed/Sat at a steady 7/10.

meta.selection: index = (days since startDate) mod 365, day 1 = startDate (a Monday). Default startDate 2026-11-02.
